Monsoon Clouds Cover 95% of India, Satellite Images Reveal

Satellite images from ISRO show that monsoon clouds currently cover 95% of India. A vast cloud belt, stretching approximately 10,000 kilometers from India to South Korea, has been captured. The images indicate the extent and intensity of the current monsoon season across the country.
